title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device –Strawberry Ice
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only The Strawberry Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack keeps your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K kit performing at its best. Each pack provides a 2ml prefilled pod alongside an 8ml refill container, together offering up to 10,000 puffs with dependable consistency. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, these pods deliver a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation system. The Strawberry Ice flavour delivers the ripe sweetness of fresh Strawberry, lifted by a frosty finish. Bright and fruity with a cool edge, this flavour balances summery sweetness with icy refreshment for a vape that feels vivid from first puff to last. The transparent pod design and clean refill process ensure easy monitoring and hassle-free use. Explore all 28 flavours from the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K collection here at Vapestore.
